jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Customer Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk.

We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel.

As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work — from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Customer Engineering is a brand-new function at Harmonic, and you'll be one of the first people to build it. This is a deliberate philosophy, not just a new team name: we're treating customer experience as an engineering problem. Every repeated question or manual fix is a signal that something should be automated, instrumented, or resolved at the root, not answered by hand.

The mission is simple to state and hard to do well: give customers fast, accurate answers, and use engineering to make the next hundred questions faster to answer than the last one. That means real backend work - fixing bugs, shipping small customer-driven improvements, and building automation and tooling that reduces how much of this has to be done by hand at all. You'll have direct influence over how this function is run, tooled, and measured from day one.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to sit inside Customer Engineering rather than the product roadmap team. You'll be the technical backbone for how we support and delight customers day-to-day: triaging and fixing bugs, resolving smallish customer requests, spotting opportunities to get ahead of a problem or surprise a customer with something they didn't ask for, and - critically - building tools and automation that let customers (and the team around you) get answers without needing an engineer in the loop every time. You'll work across our core applications, identity providers, and data security platforms, and you'll bring the same engineering rigor to this function as you would to product work - just pointed at a different problem.

What You'll Do

  • Triage, diagnose, and fix customer-reported bugs across our backend services

  • Deliver smallish customer-driven requests and improvements, keeping a lightweight roadmap of your own

  • Build tooling and automation that let customers and internal teams self-serve answers, cutting down repeat questions that would otherwise need an engineer

  • Dig into microservices, event-driven pipelines, and integrations with identity providers and data security platforms to find and resolve root causes, not just symptoms

  • Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand what's actually blocking them, then decide whether the right fix is a patch, a tool, or a process change

  • Instrument and monitor the systems customers depend on so recurring issues get surfaced and fixed before they pile up - and so you can spot chances to reach out or ship something before a customer even raises it

  • Look for moments to delight, not just resolve: a workflow that could be smoother, a report that could be automatic, a question that could be answered before it's asked

  • Track how much of the customer experience is still manual, and systematically drive that down through automation and fixes

  • Help define what "good" looks like for this function - process, tooling, and metrics - since you're building it from scratch

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services and distributed systems in the Java ecosystem (Java, Spring Boot, Maven)

  • Strong understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing patterns, messaging systems, and distributed system design

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs, web hooks, and service-to-service integrations

  • Comfortable operating in AWS, GCP, or Azure environments and working with modern observability tooling, logging, and monitoring platforms

  • A track record of delivering performant, reliable and scalable applications

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional teams, including direct, empathetic communication with customers

  • Comfortable moving between hands-on debugging, small feature delivery, and building internal tooling in the same week

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Have experience building products in cybersecurity, identity, governance, compliance, data protection, or enterprise SaaS environments

  • You understand not just how to build systems, but why architectural decisions matter

  • You can balance scalability, reliability, maintainability, and speed of execution

  • You think critically about security, observability, and operational excellence from day one

  • Love the idea of blending software development, distributed systems and data-intensive applications

  • Strong familiarity with authentication and identity technologies such as OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, SCIM, Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, or other enterprise identity providers

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm

  • Enjoy shaping culture and engineering practices, not just writing code - especially for a function that doesn't exist yet

  • Get satisfaction from unblocking a customer quickly, and then from automating away the need to do it again

  • Prefer variety and a mix of problem sizes over long, single-threaded builds

  • Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits - 401K, pension plan, generous PTO, and flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

jobs.title: Senior Software Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work — from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating fast. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Security Engineer to become the authority on our platform's security architecture - and to write the code that embodies it. You'll inherit a platform where the fundamentals of authentication and authorization, secrets and key management, encryption, and multi-tenant data isolation are established, and your job is to sharpen, harden, and evolve them with the depth a dedicated specialist brings that a generalist team can't. You will establish standards and enable the rest of the team to adhere to them. You'll spend the majority of your time writing production code, not producing reports on someone else's.

This is deliberately not a role for someone who wants to sit on a security team finding holes in what other people have already shipped. We want someone who'd rather build the fix into the architecture in the first place - hands-on, opinionated, and accountable for the outcome.

What You'll Do

  • Take formal ownership of Harmonic's platform security architecture - authentication and authorization, secrets and key management, encryption at rest and in transit, and multi-tenant data isolation - and evolve it beyond what a generalist engineering team has had the focus to do

  • Write production code using our existing languages and tooling (primarily Java, Terraform also Typescript, Rust, Python) to harden and extends these patterns in our core platform.

  • Collaborate closely with the platform team, who own our architecture and engineering standards, so that security standards are woven into that shared framework rather than sitting alongside it - you'll shape architectural decisions together, not hand requirements over the fence

  • Manage your own backlog of platform security improvements, prioritized independently of the product roadmap

  • Run threat modeling and architecture reviews on major new systems and integrations before they ship, so security is designed in rather than retrofitted

  • Create a close partnership with the Security team to provide evidence that we are adhering to required standards and ensure they are informed where we go beyond

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep specialization in security architecture rather than general backend development

  • Strong working knowledge of Java, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or OpenTofu

  • Experience with AWS and its security fundamentals - IAM, network security, container and secrets management.

  • Strong grounding in threat modeling and secure-by-design principles, applied to real architectural decisions rather than theoretical frameworks

  • Comfort setting technical standards that other engineers are expected to follow, with the communication skill to bring people along rather than dictate from a distance

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Have built or hardened platform-level security in a SaaS company that faces serious enterprise scrutiny (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires, or similar)

  • Would rather build the fix into the architecture than find the next hole in someone else's code

  • Have no patience for security theatre - you measure success by real, shipped improvements to our security posture, not policies, paperwork, or box-ticking that only looks like progress

  • Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better

  • Enjoy being the go-to authority on a topic and setting the standard, rather than gatekeeping other people's work

  • Are comfortable being the first specialist in this seat, inheriting a solid foundation and having the autonomy - and responsibility - to take it further

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm

Why Join Us

We're still small enough that every hire changes the company.

If you're looking for a role where you can build, make decisions, and have a real impact, you'll find that here. You'll work closely with experienced leaders, help shape how we scale, and have a direct hand in building the kind of company people want to work at.

  • Recognized momentum — named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity — join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity — a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits — 401K/pension, generous PTO, flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team — transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites — past trips include Lisbon and Nashville

  • Real ownership — you'll shape the platform, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

secondaryLocations.location: United States - 100% Remote (Must be in Eastern Time Zone)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building automated workflows. We expect every new hire to bring genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to working smarter and faster with it.

For some, this means staying open to new tools. For others, it means architecting new systems with AI at the core. We're transparent about expectations for every role, and we give you the tools and support to thrive.

About the Team

The GTM organization is on a mission to scale Harmonic, and marketing sits at the center of it. This role reports into the Director of Demand Generation and works hand in glove with our strategic sales team, the reps carrying our largest, most complex accounts.

We're coming off wins against Fortune 10 companies, where we're now rolling out to millions of end users. That changes the game for how we market to the top of our list. These aren't accounts you win with a webinar invite and a nurture track. They take precision, creativity, and a marketer who treats a named list of accounts like their own book of business.

About the Role

This role exists because our most strategic accounts deserve marketing built specifically for them, not a scaled-down version of what we run everywhere else.

You'll own account-based marketing for a curated set of top-tier prospects, partnering directly with the strategic sales team to open doors, build momentum, and drive pipeline inside the accounts that matter most. You'll orchestrate multi-channel plays across email (Instantly), LinkedIn (HeyReach), direct mail, events, and whatever creative idea earns a response from a hard-to-reach buyer. Some days you'll be building a sequence with a rep. Other days you'll be planning a dinner, shipping a physical mailer, or designing a play no one at Harmonic has tried yet.

What makes this different is the story you get to tell. Harmonic gives the world's largest enterprises deep usage intelligence into how their people actually use AI, so they can drive their AI programs forward while keeping the guardrails in place. That's a message strategic buyers want to hear, and your job is to get it in front of the right person, at the right account, in a way they can't ignore.

This is a hands-on, build-it role. If you want to set strategy and hand it off, this isn't it. The list is small, the stakes are high, and we need someone hungry enough to do the unscalable things that actually move a strategic account.

What You'll Do

  • Own account-based marketing for a curated set of strategic, top-tier prospects, working as a true partner to the strategic sales reps who cover them

  • Build and run multi-channel account plays across email (Instantly), LinkedIn (HeyReach), direct mail, events, and creative one-off tactics tailored to individual accounts

  • Turn Harmonic's story, deep AI usage intelligence with the guardrails enterprises need, into messaging that lands with senior security and business buyers

  • Partner with sales on account selection, contact mapping, and the plays most likely to open and advance each account

  • Plan and execute events, dinners, and field activities that get strategic buyers in the room

  • Design and ship direct mail and physical touchpoints that break through where digital can't

  • Track engagement and pipeline impact at the account level, and double down on what works

  • Bring new creative ideas to the table constantly, and test them fast

What You Bring

  • 1-3 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment

  • Must reside in NYC OR located on the East coast to support our UK team

  • Hunger. You're proactive, resourceful, and you'd rather try five things this week than wait for the perfect plan

  • Hands-on experience running outbound and multi-channel campaigns, and comfort in tools like Instantly, HeyReach, or similar

  • A genuine partnership instinct with sales, you see reps as teammates, not internal customers

  • Sharp writing and messaging judgment: you can take a technical story and make it land with a busy executive

  • Creativity and a bias for action, especially the unscalable, memorable tactics that win strategic accounts

  • An AI-native mindset: you use AI tools to move faster and you're actively experimenting with what's next

Nice-to-have

  • Experience marketing to enterprise or Fortune 500/Fortune 10 accounts

  • Event and field marketing experience, from dinners to conferences

  • Direct mail or creative physical campaign experience

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity, AI, or another technical category

  • HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing platform fluency (tool-agnostic candidates welcome: we care about judgment, not platform familiarity)

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Treat a named list of accounts like it's your own business to win

  • Get restless when a strategic account goes quiet, and do something creative about it

  • Would rather send a handwritten note and a thoughtful gift than one more email blast

  • Love working shoulder to shoulder with sales and measuring yourself on pipeline, not activity

  • Find ambiguity energising: you're good at figuring out what should exist and making it exist

  • Are actively building with AI tools, not waiting to see where things land

  • Bring ideas no one asked for, then go run the experiment

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 30 days: you know your strategic account list cold, you've built strong working relationships with the reps who cover them, and you have your first plays live

  • Within 90 days: multi-channel account plays are running across email, LinkedIn, and at least one creative or field tactic, and you're generating measurable engagement inside target accounts

  • Within 6 months: you own strategic ABM end to end, you've driven meetings and pipeline inside top-tier accounts, and sales sees you as essential to how they win their biggest deals

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job, it's a chance to help define a category, and to build this chapter of the story from its first page. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

  • Recognized momentum: named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity: join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity: a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits: 401K, generous PTO

  • A small, high-trust team: transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites: past trips include Lisbon and Nashville

  • Real ownership: you'll shape a new part of the company from day one

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.
